request.prompt: [Subject & Action] A futuristic digital video editor's workstation dissecting TikTok viral video materials: floating 3D holographic video film frames broken down layer by layer, glowing hook timing markers, visual CTA burst icons, and segmented soundwave audio tracks. [Style & Aesthetics] Cybernetic studio aesthetic, translucent holographic screens, matte dark slate surfaces, electric turquoise and neon coral laser accents, Octane 3D render. [Lighting & Atmosphere] Volumetric light shafts, glowing screen reflections, dramatic moody atmosphere. [Composition & Constraints] Widescreen 16:9 landscape aspect ratio, centered balanced layout, 8k resolution, no text, no gibberish characters, no watermark.
